### 🟡 Changes recommended Offline fixtures still access the operator’s native keyring, while other active findings identify broken standard acceptance runs, lost API gateway routing, and missing direct capability-output coverage.
4 open issues - [Enforce keyring isolation for offline fixtures](https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14927#discussion_r4460644833) · New - [Keep full acceptance runs usable without ghdebug](https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14927#discussion_r4460644885) · New - [Preserve the API gateway in isolated lifecycle config](https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14927#discussion_r4460644943) · New - [Test capability output for keyring isolation](https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14927#discussion_r4460645011) · New
What changed in this PR This final layer of the multi-account prototype stack adds guided setup and evaluation tools around the existing identity system. It remains a draft experiment, not a merge-ready design. **Changes:** - Adds approval-focused onboarding guidance and evaluation scenarios. - Introduces live walkthroughs, offline regression journeys, and reset/downgrade checks. - Adds debug-only keyring isolation and a protected acceptance lifecycle. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `script/​multiaccount-review/​08-reset.sh` | configuration preservation across reset and downgrade. | | `script/​identity-e2e/​README.md` | Documents setup, evaluation, limitations, and recovery. | | `script/​identity-e2e/​offline_test.go` |
